gloss: to mix in, to intersperse, to include

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {交|ま}じえていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to mix in, to intersperse, to include
definitions.explanation: To include or mix different elements together. Often used for mixing things like humor into speech, or different items into a group.
To engage with an opponent, as in exchanging fire or fighting a battle; also used in a set phrase for talking closely, knee to knee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|ま}じえて⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: To speak with humor mixed in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|ま}じえて⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I explained it mixing English into my Japanese.

examples.japanese: {両軍|りょうぐん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国境|こっきょう}→国境：02762_kokkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{砲火|ほうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|ま}じえた。
examples.english: The two armies exchanged fire at the border.

notes:
{交|ま}じえる has two main uses: (1) to mix in or intersperse different elements, and (2) to engage with an opponent (fire, blows, a battle).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: {交|ま}じる (intransitive — to be mixed in, to mingle)

ASPECT (ている):
{交|ま}じえて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means the mixing/interspersing is ongoing or the mixed state persists.

SENSE 1 — MIX IN:
- ⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|ま}じえて⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak with humor mixed in
- ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|ま}じえる: to mix in English
- ⟦{実例|じつれい}→実例：04217_jitsurei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|ま}じえて⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧: to explain with real examples interspersed

SENSE 2 — EXCHANGE:
- {砲火|ほうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|ま}じえる: to exchange fire
- ⟦{一戦|いっせん}→一戦：16246_issen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|ま}じえる: to fight a battle
- ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|ま}じえて⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to talk closely, knee to knee

WATCH OUT:
Exchanging words, glances, or greetings takes ⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧: ⟦{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす→言葉を交わす：19502_kotobawokawasu⟧, ⟦{視線|しせん}→視線：14138_shisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧ (not {交|ま}じえる).

REGISTER:
Slightly formal/literary. In casual speech, ⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧ is more common for physical mixing.
